title: CMS Website Building
desc: Professional websites built on GoHighLevel, Square Online, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Framer and other leading platforms. Perfect when you need a fast, branded, conversion-focused site without heavy custom code. Fully matched to your business goals and easy for you to edit later.
deliverables: Platform selection advice based on your business needs
Complete site setup, branding, colors, fonts & logo integration
Custom page structure (Home, Services, About, Contact, etc.)
E-commerce, booking, or lead-funnel integration where needed
Mobile-first responsive design across all devices
DNS / domain connection & basic SEO setup
1-on-1 video walkthrough so you can edit content yourself
Handover of all logins and clear documentation
